mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as stronger demand boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of triggered instances despite GDPC1 rising, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains ≥2.0% and 20d returns are negative, or effect not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicate a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not rise, or returns are negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (UNRATE >6.1%), sustained increases in UNRATE predict positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as improved labor conditions boost consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 6.1% in the recovery regime, or returns are negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as lower inflation expectations lower risk premiums and improve equity valuations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not decline in the next month, or returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in HOUST below 900 units triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as reduced demand signals weakening economic activity and investor pessimism.
failure_condition: HOUST remains ≥900 when trigger occurs, or returns are not negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% and quarterly rises in GDPC1 signal monetary easing and robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS does not fall below 2.0% or GDPC1 does not rise, or returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO >110.3), sustained increases in INDPRO predict positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as excess supply pressures drive down valuations and improve fundamentals.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise in the expansion regime, or returns are negative (p>0.05).
